generate_gtest_pred_impl: generate Google Test predicate assertion header and unit test files for a given maximum arity
generate_header_pred_impl: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file implementing predicate assertion macros up to a given arity
generate_unit_test_pred_impl: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file for predicate assertions up to a given arity
run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run the script with a maximum arity argument to generate predicate assertion implementations and tests
summarize_gen_gtest_pred_impl: summarize the gen_gtest_pred_impl.py script that generates Google Test predicate assertion macros and unit tests
